Third-party files in this folder (bundled locally so the app runs
offline and without any CDN):

- tesseract.min.js, worker.min.js
  tesseract.js 7.0.0 — Apache License 2.0
  https://github.com/naptha/tesseract.js
  (includes regenerator-runtime, MIT, Copyright Facebook, Inc.)

- tesseract-core-simd-lstm.wasm.js, tesseract-core-simd-lstm.wasm
  tesseract.js-core — Apache License 2.0
  https://github.com/naptha/tesseract.js-core
  (compiled Tesseract OCR, Apache License 2.0,
  https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tesseract)

- paddle/ort.wasm.min.js, paddle/ort-wasm-simd-threaded.mjs, paddle/ort-wasm-simd-threaded.wasm
  ONNX Runtime Web 1.30.0 — MIT License, Copyright (c) Microsoft Corporation
  https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime

- paddle/ch_PP-OCRv4_det_infer.onnx, paddle/ch_PP-OCRv4_rec_infer.onnx, paddle/ppocr_keys_v1.txt
  PaddleOCR PP-OCRv4 mobile models for Chinese (text detection and recognition) and
  their character list — Apache License 2.0, Copyright (c) PaddlePaddle Authors
  https://github.com/PaddlePaddle/PaddleOCR
  The models in ONNX form as published in the npm package @gutenye/ocr-models 1.4.2
  (MIT, https://github.com/gutenye/ocr), unmodified.

- pinyin-pro.js
  pinyin-pro 3.29.3 — MIT License
  https://github.com/zh-lx/pinyin-pro

- chi_sim.traineddata.gz
  tessdata_fast (Simplified Chinese) — Apache License 2.0
  https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tessdata_fast

- chi_tra.traineddata.gz
  tessdata_fast (Traditional Chinese) — Apache License 2.0
  https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tessdata_fast

- t2s.txt, s2t.txt
  Traditional→simplified and simplified→traditional character pairs
  derived from OpenCC's TSCharacters.txt and STCharacters.txt — Apache License 2.0
  https://github.com/BYVoid/OpenCC

- cedict.tsv.gz
  Derived from CC-CEDICT (Chinese-English dictionary),
  via the cedict-json npm package — CC BY-SA 4.0
  https://www.mdbg.net/chinese/dictionary?page=cc-cedict
  This derived file is likewise licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0.
  Modifications: one line per simplified word, the English senses of an entry
  joined with "; " and cut to 120 characters; the traditional forms and the
  classifiers dropped. On 20 September 2026 the 1,210 words that have more
  than one reading were given their readings back — one group per reading,
  separated by U+001F, each opening with its tone-marked pinyin in brackets.
  The script that does it is tools/cedict-readings.py in this repository.

- nmt/bergamot-translator-worker.js, nmt/bergamot-translator-worker.wasm,
  nmt/translator-worker.js
  @browsermt/bergamot-translator 0.4.9 (Bergamot / Firefox Translations
  engine, marian-nmt compiled to WebAssembly) — Mozilla Public License 2.0
  https://github.com/browsermt/bergamot-translator
  https://www.npmjs.com/package/@browsermt/bergamot-translator

- nmt/model.zhen.intgemm.alphas.bin.gz, nmt/lex.50.50.zhen.s2t.bin.gz,
  nmt/vocab.zhen.spm.gz (added by the "Fetch zh→en translation model"
  GitHub Action)
  Firefox Translations zh→en "base-memory" model — Mozilla Public License 2.0
  https://github.com/mozilla/firefox-translations-models

- strokes.txt.gz
  Stroke medians of 9,534 characters, extracted from graphics.txt of Make Me a Hanzi
  (https://github.com/skishore/makemeahanzi, Shaunak Kishore), which derives them from the
  Arphic PL KaitiM GB and Arphic PL UKai fonts (Arphic Technology).
  ARPHIC PUBLIC LICENSE (1999) — the full text is beside this file as ARPHICPL.TXT,
  which that license requires to be retained unaltered in every copy.
  Modification, as its section 2 a) asks: on 3 September 2026, for this app, graphics.txt was
  reduced to the character and its per-stroke median points, with y flipped to screen
  coordinates and the values rounded to whole pixels; the outlines, stroke matches and radical
  data were dropped. Section 2 b) asks that such modifications stay freely available under the
  same license to everyone — strokes.txt.gz is published at
  https://github.com/henglicam/zeichentrainer and must remain so.

- outlines.txt.gz
  The outline of every stroke of the same 9,534 characters, from the same graphics.txt of
  Make Me a Hanzi, and so from the same Arphic PL KaitiM GB and Arphic PL UKai fonts.
  ARPHIC PUBLIC LICENSE (1999) — ARPHICPL.TXT, beside this file, retained unaltered.
  Modification, as its section 2 a) asks: on 18 September 2026, for this app, graphics.txt was
  reduced to the character and its per-stroke outline paths, with the path coordinates divided
  by four onto a 256 grid and rounded to whole units; the y axis is left as the source has it
  and is flipped when the path is drawn. Section 2 b) asks that such modifications stay freely
  available under the same license to everyone — outlines.txt.gz is published at
  https://github.com/henglicam/zeichentrainer and must remain so.

  (Make Me a Hanzi's dictionary.txt is LGPL-licensed and is NOT used here.)

Conditions that travel with these files, in short:
  Apache-2.0 — keep the notice and the license; no NOTICE file exists upstream for any of the
    Apache-licensed items above, so there is nothing further to reproduce.
  MIT — keep the copyright notice and the license.
  MPL-2.0 — the .wasm and .js are distributed unmodified; the Source Code Form is at the
    addresses given above, which is what section 3.2 asks for.
  CC BY-SA 4.0 — attribution as given above, and the derived dictionary (cedict.tsv.gz) is
    itself under CC BY-SA 4.0 and must stay available under it.
  ARPHIC (1999) — as set out above; the license states that a fee may be charged.
All of these permit commercial use. None of them places its terms on the app's own code:
each of them treats separate works aggregated on the same medium as separate works.

Full license texts:
  Apache License 2.0 — https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0
  MIT — https://opensource.org/license/mit
  MPL 2.0 — https://www.mozilla.org/MPL/2.0/
  CC BY-SA 4.0 — https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/
  ARPHIC PUBLIC LICENSE (1999) — ARPHICPL.TXT, beside this file
